name: Atlas CMMS
description: Atlas CMMS is a self-hosted maintenance management system for web and mobile. It tracks work orders, preventive maintenance, assets, locations, parts and inventory, vendors and customers, with analytics, approval workflows and an Android/iOS app that connects to your own server.

notes.text: Sign up on the login page to create the first organization and its admin. Anyone who can reach the port can do the same until ALLOWED_ORGANIZATION_ADMINS is set in /opt/atlas-cmms_data/.env.

Links and file downloads use the container IP. Behind a domain or reverse proxy, change PUBLIC_API_URL, PUBLIC_FRONT_URL and PUBLIC_MINIO_ENDPOINT in /opt/atlas-cmms_data/.env and run systemctl restart atlas-cmms.
Email (notifications, invitations, password reset) is off until SMTP_* and ENABLE_EMAIL_NOTIFICATIONS are set in /opt/atlas-cmms_data/.env.
